command:
set -e
if [ ! -d /data/geth ]; then
  echo "[l2-geth] initializing genesis..."
  geth init --state.scheme=hash --datadir /data /config/genesis-l2.json
fi
exec geth \
  --http --http.addr=0.0.0.0 --http.api=eth,net,web3,debug,txpool \
  --http.vhosts="*" \
  --ws --ws.addr=0.0.0.0 --ws.origins="*" \
  --authrpc.addr=0.0.0.0 --authrpc.port=8551 --authrpc.vhosts="*" --authrpc.jwtsecret=/config/jwt.txt\
  --datadir=/data \
  --networkid=901 \
  --state.scheme=hash \
  --gcmode=archive \
  --metrics --metrics.addr=0.0.0.0 --metrics.port=6060 \
  --rollup.computependingblock=true \
  --rollup.enabletxpooladmission=true \
  --rollup.disabletxpoolgossip=false

set -e
ENODE_L2="enode://ee9270b480cc105aae5217e7d7fc175ea2a0e15fdda90947ecbfd23b89607f79c1a21890091ff13c058c12c6629c198c65d343db6164dc0a0d5a9310cd95cad6@l2-geth:30303"
if [ ! -d /data/geth ]; then
  echo "[l3-geth] initializing genesis..."
  geth init --datadir /data /config/genesis.json
fi
echo "[\"$$ENODE_L2\"]" > /data/static-nodes.json
exec geth \
  --http --http.addr=0.0.0.0 --http.api=eth,net,web3,debug \
  --http.vhosts="*" \
  --ws --ws.addr=0.0.0.0 --ws.origins="*" \
  --authrpc.addr=0.0.0.0 --authrpc.port=8551 --authrpc.vhosts="*" --authrpc.jwtsecret=/config/jwt.txt \
  --datadir=/data \
  --networkid=903 \
  --gcmode=archive \
  --bootnodes=$$ENODE_L2 \
  --nodiscover \
  --rollup.enabletxpooladmission=true \
  --rollup.disabletxpoolgossip=false
